lines.en: label wakanaspring6:
scene wakanaamioffice1
It was lunchtime at Kumon-mi High, which meant Ami Arakawa was going to go sit in the classroom and wait for it to be over.
lines.zh: 这是 Kumon-mi 高中的午休时间，也就是说荒川 Ami 要去教室里坐着，等它过去。

lines.en: She didn’t {i}need{/i} to. No one really {i}hated{/i} her and her friends still existed. But she was going to anyway because it just never felt right being around them anymore.
lines.zh: 她其实{i}不必{/i}这样。没人真的{i}讨厌{/i}她，她的朋友也还在。可她还是打算这么做——因为跟她们待在一起，总觉得哪儿不对劲了。

lines.en: And while her definition of “right” is clearly different from ours as evidenced by her place on the forced orgasm leaderboard, it’s still important that we respect her outlook and decisions.
lines.zh: 虽然她对「对」的定义显然跟我们不一样——她在强制高潮排行榜上的位置就是明证——但我们依然该尊重她的看法和决定。

lines.en: Even when those decisions wind up pushing more people away.
lines.zh: 哪怕这些决定最后会把更多人推开。

lines.en: But does she get that from her father? Or does {i}he{/i} get it from her?
lines.zh: 可这是她从她父亲那儿学来的？还是{i}他{/i}从她那儿学来的？

lines.en: It’s an interesting question, I think. But one that won’t be answered today as there is a new elephant in the room.
lines.zh: 我觉得这是个有意思的问题。但今天不会有答案——因为屋子里多了一头新的大象。

lines.en: And this one smells like earl grey.
lines.zh: 而这头大象闻起来是伯爵茶的味道。

lines.en: : Oh, Arakawa Jr.
lines.zh: : 哦，荒川二世。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice2
: Hm?
scene wakanaamioffice3
: How convenient. I just stepped out my office to come look for you and I’ve barely made it ten feet. Perhaps god is real after all?
lines.zh: : 真巧。我刚走出办公室要找你，还没走十步就撞上了。也许上帝是真的存在？

lines.en: : You’re looking for {i}me?{/i} Why? Did I do something wrong?
lines.zh: : 你在找{i}我？{/i}为什么？我做错什么了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice4
: Wait — I’m not being transferred, am I? Because I know I’ve failed my last three quizzes, but I can promise you that there is a perfectly reasonable explanation for that.
lines.zh: : 等等——我不会是要被转走吧？我知道我最近三次小测都不及格，但我可以保证，对此有个非常合理的解释。

lines.en: : I am dumb.
lines.zh: : 我就是笨。

lines.en: : You’re not being transferred, Arakawa Jr. Though, this information will help me once again assert my superiority over Miss Imai, so thank you for that.
lines.zh: : 你不会被转走，荒川二世。不过这条情报能让我再次压过今井老师一头，所以谢了。

lines.en: : Well, if I’m not being transferred and I’m not in trouble-
lines.zh: : 那，既然我不会被转走、也没有惹麻烦——

lines.en: : Technically, I never said you’re not in trouble.
lines.zh: : 严格说来，我从没说过你没惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice5
: Well, what did I do then?! You never come up to me and it’s scaring me based on what I’ve heard about you as a teacher!
lines.zh: : 那我到底做了什么？！你从来不主动找我，而且我听说的那些关于你当老师的事，让我很害怕！

lines.en: : Just come with me to my office and we can talk more about that, okay? I promise I won’t inflict any harm upon you.
lines.zh: : 跟我来办公室，我们再细谈，好吗？我保证不会对你施加任何伤害。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice6
: I don’t know if I believe you after the whole janitor murder court case thing, since it wasn’t very clear if that was actually a real thing that happened or not.
lines.zh: : 在「校工谋杀案庭审」那件事之后，我不确定该不该信你——毕竟一直没弄清楚那到底是不是真发生过。

lines.en: : Well, if it {i}was,{/i} it’s not as if we actually {i}need{/i} them since all of you are perfectly capable of cleaning the school yourselves.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就{i}算是{/i}吧，我们其实也不怎么{i}需要{/i}他们——反正你们自己完全有能力打扫学校。

lines.en: : You don’t have to remind me. I’m on cleaning duty today.
lines.zh: : 不用提醒我。今天轮到我打扫。

lines.en: : I can get you out of it...for a price.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你免掉……只不过有个代价。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice7
: Why are you blushing? Don’t blush. Stop that.
lines.zh: : 你脸红什么？别红。别红。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice8
: I should have known the moment you asked me to come to your office. I just never realized you thought of me that way...but I guess it’s fine so long as it gets me out of cleaning duty.
lines.zh: : 你叫我来办公室的时候我就该知道了。我只是从没想过你是那样看我的……不过既然能让我免了打扫，我想也没关系。

lines.en: : I swear, both you {i}and{/i} your father are the same brand of infuriatingly suggestive. What a terrible combination the two of you make.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，你{i}和{/i}你父亲是同一种气死人的「引人遐想」。你们俩凑一块儿真是糟糕透顶的组合。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice9
: You can do whatever you want to me in your office, but can we please not talk about him? It’s kind of a sore spot right now.
lines.zh: : 你在办公室里想对我做什么都行，但我们能不能别谈他？现在这是块痛点。

lines.en: : I know. That’s specifically {i}what{/i} I want to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我要谈的正是{i}这个{/i}。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice10
: Oh!.......So you {i}don’t{/i} want to tie me up then?
lines.zh: : 哦！……所以你{i}不{/i}是要绑我了？

lines.en: : No! And just joking about such things could cost me my job, so shut your delinquent mouth and just follow me to my office already!
lines.zh: : 不是！光是拿这种事开玩笑就够让我丢饭碗了，所以闭上你那张不良少女的嘴，赶紧跟我去办公室！

lines.en: scene black
: I doubt it could cost you your job, Miss Watabe. Far worse things have been both said {i}and{/i} done in this school.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑这不足以让你丢工作，渡边老师。这所学校里说过、做过的更过分的事多了去了。

lines.en: : What do you mean “done?” What do you know that I don’t?
lines.zh: : 「做过」是什么意思？你知道什么我不知道的？

lines.en: : A lot, I imagine. But I’m not trying to get anybody in trouble, so- woah!
lines.zh: : 大概很多吧。不过我不想给谁惹麻烦，所以——哇哦！

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice11
: Your office is so much nicer than my dad’s...I mean Sensei’s. I never know what to call him in school.
lines.zh: : 你的办公室比我爸爸的好太多了……我是说 Sensei 的。在学校里我从来不知道该怎么称呼他。

lines.en: : You can call him your husband for all I care. Titles hardly make a difference now that no one can listen in on our conversation.
lines.zh: : 你管他叫丈夫都行，我才不在乎。反正现在没人能偷听我们说话，称呼有什么要紧。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice12
: Okay. Well, since you insist, I guess I’ll just have to call him my husband for the duration of this talk.
lines.zh: : 好。既然你坚持，那这番谈话期间我就只好管他叫丈夫了。

lines.en: : I assumed you wouldn’t take that literally given your relationship with him is that of family, but I understand this one might be on me as I deluded myself into thinking you would know better.
lines.zh: : 我以为你不会当真——毕竟你跟他是亲人关系；不过这次也许怪我自己，我自欺欺人地以为你会更懂事些。

lines.en: : If it makes you happy, you can also refer to him as your husband, Ms. Watabe. Or shall I say — Mrs. Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 要是这样能让你高兴，你也可以管他叫丈夫哦，渡边老师。或者我该说——荒川太太？

lines.en: : You shall not. Ever again.
lines.zh: : 不许。永远都不许。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice13
: Oh, come on. You know you’ve thought about it. {i}Everybody{/i} has.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你明明想过。{i}所有人{/i}都想过。

lines.en: : That’s because everyone but me is an idiot.
lines.zh: : 那是因为除了我以外所有人都是白痴。

lines.en: : You don’t like him even a little? Really?
lines.zh: : 你一点都不喜欢他？真的？

lines.en: : I didn’t bring you here to solicit a date with your father-uncle-thing, Arakawa Jr. I’m more than capable of asking him out myself if I ever give up on the idea of happiness.
lines.zh: : 我把你叫来，不是为了求你给我牵线、跟你那个「爸爸兼舅舅」约会，荒川二世。要是我哪天放弃了追求幸福，我自己约他就够了。

lines.en: : Well, why {i}did{/i} you ask me here then? Because you said it was about him. And normally, when someone says that to me, it’s because they want to sleep with him.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么叫我过来？因为你说这事跟他有关。而且通常别人跟我说这种话，都是因为想跟他上床。

lines.en: : I want to talk about {i}both{/i} of you. As a...{i}singular unit.{/i} And try to better understand the situation at home.
lines.zh: : 我想谈谈{i}你们俩{/i}。作为一个……{i}整体{/i}。想弄明白家里的情况。

lines.en: : You mean like a guidance counselor?
lines.zh: : 你是说像心理辅导老师那样？

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} technically part of my job here. Though, I imagine I’m supposed to be filling that role for {i}my{/i} students rather than Imaikawa’s.
lines.zh: : 按理说那{i}也是{/i}我工作的一部分。不过我想，这个角色我该对{i}我的{/i}学生去扮演，而不是对今井川老师的。

lines.en: : Did you just combine Imani’s last name into mine? Does this mean I’m interracial now?
lines.zh: : 你刚把 Imani 的姓跟我的姓合起来了？那我现在算混血了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice14
: No. It means you should take a seat before I need to open a secret drawer in my desk for something to strap you down with.
lines.zh: : 不。意思是：你最好坐下，免得我得打开办公桌的暗格，找点东西把你捆起来。

lines.en: scene black
: Hey, I have one of those too!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我也有一个那种东西！

lines.en: : And I’m very happy for you, Arakawa Jr. But again, I am not here to allow you to keep deviating from the topic by tossing disgusting perversions at me.
lines.zh: : 我真替你高兴，荒川二世。不过再说一次，我不是来让你一直往我身上扔那些恶心的变态念头、好岔开话题的。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice15
: They’re hardly disgusting if you have a secret handcuff drawer.
lines.zh: : 既然你有个放手铐的暗格，它们就不算恶心了吧。

lines.en: : That’s not {i}why{/i} they’re disgusting. But I imagine the {i}age difference{/i} between us just doesn’t factor into your head at all seeing as your mother was the Girl Who Cannot Breathe.
lines.zh: : 它们恶心不是因为这个。不过我想，我们之间的{i}年龄差{/i}在你脑子里根本不算什么——毕竟你母亲是「无法呼吸的女孩」。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice16
: Oh.
: So you’re just {i}saying{/i} it now. Directly to me.
lines.zh: : 所以你就这么直接跟我{i}说{/i}了。

lines.en: : I understand that it’s a touchy subject, but I’m not here to debate the morality of her actions if that’s what you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 我知道这是个敏感话题，不过如果你担心的话——我不是来评判她行为是否道德的。

lines.en: : She was extremely talented regardless of the things that she did. And she passed that talent down to both your {i}husband{/i} and you.
lines.zh: : 不管她做过什么，她都极有才华。而她把这份才华传给了你{i}丈夫{/i}，也传给了你。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice17
: Oh, please...I’m nothing compared to her. Winning your contest was a fluke.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托……我跟她比什么都不是。赢你那个比赛纯属走运。

lines.en: : I wrote a million poems for that and Noriko’s was better than every single one. You only chose {i}me{/i} because you wanted to learn more about my mom.
lines.zh: : 我为那个写了一百万首诗，而 Noriko 的每一首都比我的好。你选{i}我{/i}只是因为你想多了解我妈妈。

lines.en: : That may have played some part in it. But I was under the impression you were unable to talk about her.
lines.zh: : 也许有这层因素。不过我印象里你是不能谈她的。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even factoring in how Arakawa Sr. told me to stop poking my nose where it doesn’t belong and just stay out of it entirely.
lines.zh: : 这还没算上荒川前辈叫我别多管闲事、彻底别插手这件事。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice18
: But you didn’t...and I’m supposed to believe you went through all of that effort just so you can tell me I’m {i}talented?{/i} What do you {i}really{/i} want, Ms. Watabe?
lines.zh: : 但你没听……而我要相信你费了这么大劲，就为了告诉我我{i}有才华{/i}？你{i}到底{/i}想要什么，渡边老师？

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice19
: Heh...that’s a good question.
lines.zh: : 呵……问得好。

lines.en: : I spent so long trying to uncover the relationship between the three of you that hearing it straight from the horse’s mouth felt somewhat...anticlimactic when all was said and done.
lines.zh: : 我花了那么久想弄清你们三人之间的关系，结果从当事人口中亲耳听到时，到头来却有点……索然无味。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure {i}what{/i} to do anymore.
lines.zh: : 我真的不确定接下来该{i}怎么{/i}办了。

lines.en: : So am {i}I{/i} the horse? Or is my {i}dad{/i} the horse? Because I assume you talked to him and I assume he’s the one who put you up to this.
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}是那匹马？还是我{i}爸{/i}是那匹马？因为我猜你跟他谈过了，也猜是他让你来干的。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice20
: Is {i}this{/i} what you’re like when the charade drops? The two of you really {i}do{/i} have so much in common, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 假面摘下来之后你就是{i}这个{/i}样子？你们俩还{i}真是{/i}有很多共同点啊。

lines.en: : There is no “charade.” I just try to limit the amount of people who know the specifics of my upbringing since all it does is garner pity and misunderstandings.
lines.zh: : 没有什么「假面」。我只是尽量减少知道我成长细节的人的数量，因为那只会换来同情和误解。

lines.en: : Like I said — I’m not here to talk about morality. And I don’t need to read a dead woman’s non-existent autobiography to pity the girl she left behind.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的——我不是来谈道德的。而我也不需要读一个死女人根本不存在的自传，才会去同情她留下的那个女孩。

lines.en: : I’m here to remind you that you’re the only piece left of your mother. And that every second you spend away from your “father” is like her leaving all over again.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿是想提醒你：你是你母亲留下的唯一一块碎片。而你每离开你「父亲」一秒，就像她又离开了一次。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice21
: He...told you to say that?
lines.zh: : 他……让你这么说的？

lines.en: : Those are my words, not his. We both know how unwilling he is to put actual thought into any of what he says.
lines.zh: : 那是我的话，不是他的。我们俩都知道，他有多不愿意为他说的任何一句话真正动过脑子。

lines.en: : I can tell you he’s hurting, though. That he’s {i}sorry.{/i} And that he wants you to come home. Even {i}if{/i} you’re a terror.
lines.zh: : 不过我可以告诉你：他很痛苦。他很{i}抱歉{/i}。他想让你回家。{i}哪怕{/i}你是个小恶魔。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice22
: Why did you run out anyway? Just trying to make him feel bad? Did you two get into a fight?
lines.zh: : 话说你为什么要离家出走？就为了让他难受？你俩吵架了？

lines.en: : Is this what {i}you’re{/i} like when the charade drops? {i}Nice?{/i}
lines.zh: : 假面摘下来之后{i}你{/i}就是这个样子？{i}挺好人{/i}的？

lines.en: : I have my moments, I suppose. And quite frankly, I think your family is rather disgusting.
lines.zh: : 我想我偶尔也有这种时候。而且说实话，我觉得你们家挺恶心的。

lines.en: : But Arakawa Sr. has taken up residence somewhere inside of my heart. And it’d feel wrong to just evict him when he’s already struggling so much.
lines.zh: : 可荒川前辈已经在我心里某个地方住下了。既然他已经这么难受，把他直接赶走，我觉得不对。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice23
: Do you pity him?
lines.zh: : 你同情他吗？

lines.en: : Arakawa? Why? Because he was sleeping with your mother? Or because he’s a completely and utterly helpless excuse for a man?
lines.zh: : 荒川？为什么？因为他跟你母亲上过床？还是因为他是个彻头彻尾、无可救药的废物男人？

lines.en: : The mom thing. Like...there was another older woman who also found out about this recently and her reaction was way different than yours.
lines.zh: : 因为妈妈那件事。就是……最近还有一位年长女性也知道了这件事，她的反应跟你完全不一样。

lines.en: : You’re talking about that idol, aren’t you? Niki?
lines.zh: : 你说的是那个偶像吧？Niki？

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice24
: Jesus. How close {i}are{/i} you guys? Just how much did he tell you?
lines.zh: : 天呐。你们{i}到底{/i}有多亲密？他跟你说了多少？

lines.en: : He mentioned her leaving as well. But I knew the two of them were “together” before that.
lines.zh: : 他也提了她离开的事。不过在那之前我就知道他们俩「在一起」了。

lines.en: : And yes, I {i}do{/i} pity him. For {i}both{/i} of the reasons I mentioned. And I pity {i}you{/i} as well, regardless of how much you apparently want to avoid incurring such a feeling.
lines.zh: : 是的，我同情他。为了我刚才说的{i}两个{/i}理由。我也同情{i}你{/i}——不管你看起来有多想避开这种感觉。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice25
: It’s not even that I want to {i}avoid{/i} it. It’s just...such a {i}normal{/i} thing to me that it’s kind of annoying at this point.
lines.zh: : 倒不是我想{i}避开{/i}。只是……这对我来说太{i}稀松平常{/i}了，平常到有点烦人。

lines.en: : {size=-1}What I want more than anything is to just enjoy what’s left of my life with my dad. That’s all. And how am I supposed to enjoy {i}anything{/i} with people reminding me of how sad we are all the time?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}我最想要的，不过是和我爸一起好好享受我剩下的人生。就这样。可要是总有人提醒我们有多惨，我又怎么享受得了？{/size}

lines.en: : You say that like you’re going to die soon.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得好像你快要死了似的。

lines.en: : No, I say that knowing I {i}can.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，我这话是知道我随时{i}可能{/i}死才说的。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice26
: Everything can end at {i}any{/i} moment. A meteor could crash into this school right now and we’d all be burnt to a crisp. I could get an aneurysm. I could be {i}murdered.{/i}
lines.zh: : 一切{i}随时{/i}都可能结束。一颗流星现在就能砸进这所学校，把我们全都烧成焦炭。我可能得动脉瘤。我可能{i}被谋杀{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}Anything{/i} can happen. So when you spend every waking moment miserable, you’re taking away time from a very {i}finite{/i} amount of happiness available.
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}都可能发生。所以当你把清醒的每一秒都花在痛苦上，你就是在从一份非常{i}有限{/i}的幸福里偷走时间。

lines.en: : Life doesn’t just {i}start over{/i} when you die. That’s {i}it.{/i} You’re done. No more.
lines.zh: : 人死了人生不会{i}重来{/i}。就{i}这样{/i}。结束了。没有了。

lines.en: : And that’s {i}exactly{/i} what happened to my mom. Before she ever had a chance to show {i}everyone{/i} how amazing she was instead of just the people who met her.
lines.zh: : 而这{i}正是{/i}我妈身上发生的事。她还没来得及让{i}所有人{/i}（而不只是见过她的人）看见她有多了不起，就走了。

lines.en: : So tell me, Ms. Watabe — if she was so evil like you and all of your pretentious poetry friends think, why did {i}everyone{/i} in her life love her {i}so{/i} much?
lines.zh: : 所以告诉我，渡边老师——如果她真像你和你那些附庸风雅的诗人朋友认为的那么邪恶，为什么她生命里的{i}每个人{/i}都{i}那么{/i}爱她？

lines.en: : You overestimate the amount of “pretentious poetry friends” I have. Or that I’d want to discuss your mother’s works with them in general.
lines.zh: : 你高估了我「附庸风雅的诗人朋友」的数量。也高估了我想跟他们讨论你母亲作品的意愿。

lines.en: : They’re {i}amazing{/i} though, aren’t they? You said it yourself. She was talented.
lines.zh: : 可它们{i}很棒{/i}啊，不是吗？你自己说的。她有才华。

lines.en: : Extremely. But there are certain truths in this world that are accepted inevitably, and your mother challenged nearly all of them. Which is precisely what she {i}wanted{/i} to do, so-
lines.zh: : 极其有才华。但这世上有些真理迟早会被人接受，而你母亲几乎把它们全挑战了一遍。而这正是她{i}想{/i}做的，所以——

lines.en: : No, she didn’t {i}want{/i} to do that. That’s just who she {i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，她不是{i}想{/i}做那件事。她{i}本来就是{/i}那样的人。

lines.en: : She was {i}never{/i} afraid of being herself and {i}I{/i} can’t even figure out who or what I’m supposed to be yet.
lines.zh: : 她{i}从不{/i}怕做她自己，而{i}我{/i}现在连自己该是谁、该是什么都搞不清。

lines.en: : So no, I didn’t inherit her {i}talent.{/i} I inherited her scorn for a world that didn’t want her here, the infinite blame that accompanies it, and a pair of shoes I can’t ever fill.
lines.zh: : 所以不，我没继承她的{i}才华{/i}。我继承的是她对那个不欢迎她的世界的轻蔑，是随之而来的无休止的责难，还有一双我永远填不满的鞋。

lines.en: : Me going home won’t make my dad happy again. It’ll just be more charades. A bandage on a wound that’s bleeding out.
lines.zh: : 我回家不会让我爸重新开心。那只会是更多的假面。是贴在一个正在失血的伤口上的创可贴。

lines.en: : You know...you wouldn’t have to eat alone if you’d just show this side to other people.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……只要你把这一面给别人看，你就不用一个人吃饭了。

lines.en: : Stop pretending to care about {i}me{/i} just because you care about {i}him.{/i} Everyone always does that and I seriously {i}hate{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 别因为你在乎{i}他{/i}就装作在乎{i}我{/i}。所有人都这样，我真的很{i}讨厌{/i}。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice27
: But if I don’t care about you, I won’t get paid. That’s part of my job.
lines.zh: : 可要是我不在乎你，我就拿不到工资。这是我工作的一部分。

lines.en: : Sure, but...it’s not {i}everybody’s{/i} job and they all do it {i}too,{/i} so...
lines.zh: : 是，不过……那不是{i}所有人{/i}的工作，可他们{i}也{/i}都这么做，所以……

lines.en: : Do you think that Niki woman was only {i}pretending{/i} to care about you too, then? Is {i}that{/i} what you two got into a fight over?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得那个 Niki 也只是{i}装作{/i}在乎你吗？你们俩吵架是因为{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : She just...
lines.zh: : 她只是……

lines.en: : Being around her causes him pain. And that causes {i}me{/i} pain. So it’d be better if she just left.
lines.zh: : 跟她在一起让他痛苦。而那让{i}我{/i}痛苦。所以她干脆离开会更好。

lines.en: : You think you two would be happier just ignoring everything then?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你们俩就这么装作什么都没发生会更幸福？

lines.en: : Right...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对……没错。

lines.en: : Arakawa told me the same thing essentially. Just {i}he’s{/i} not writing anything down like you are. So I’m sure you understand just how much he’s keeping inside.
lines.zh: : 荒川跟我说的基本上也是这个意思。只不过{i}他{/i}没像你这样把东西写下来。所以我相信你明白他憋在心里有多少。

lines.en: : He will eventually...
lines.zh: : 他总有一天会……

lines.en: : He just needs time.
lines.zh: : 他只是需要时间。

lines.en: : But until then, don’t you think it would help him having the one he loves the most by his side?
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，你不觉得让他最爱的人陪在身边，对他会有帮助吗？

lines.en: : Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : I just doubt if that person’s actually {i}me{/i} sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我只是有时候怀疑，那个人到底是不是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice28
: I know how you feel. Trust me.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的感受。相信我。

lines.en: : But I also know that Arakawa would not have asked me to try and bring you home if he did not literally {i}need{/i} my help. And I {i}want{/i} to help him because {i}he{/i} helps me. So please-
lines.zh: : 但我也知道，要不是真的{i}需要{/i}我帮忙，荒川不会来求我试着把你带回家。而我{i}想{/i}帮他，因为{i}他{/i}帮我。所以拜托——

lines.en: : Go home. Make him happy. Or...try and fail, I suppose. Just {i}be{/i} there for him.
lines.zh: : 回家吧。让他开心。或者……试着做、然后失败，我想。只要{i}待在{/i}他身边就好。

lines.en: : You know...you’d make a good mom, Miss Watabe.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你会是个好妈妈，渡边老师。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice29
: I go this far out of my way to help you and you say {i}that?{/i} I’ve never felt so insulted in my life.
lines.zh: : 我特意绕这么大一圈来帮你，你就拿{i}这个{/i}回报我？我这辈子没受过这么大的侮辱。

lines.en: : It’s not an insult, I promise. If anything, someone like you might be {i}nice{/i} to have around the house.
lines.zh: : 这不是侮辱，我保证。要说的话，家里有个像你这样的人也许{i}挺好{/i}的。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice30
: A kind-hearted poet who just wants to get the best out of my dad...who won’t judge me for the things I feel or...try to change me into something else.
lines.zh: : 一个心地善良的诗人，只想让我爸把最好的一面拿出来……不会因为我有的那些感觉而评判我，也不会……想把我变成别的什么。

lines.en: : I will judge you heavily for the things you feel. And I can almost guarantee I’d try to change you as well as I can not even fathom living with a creature like you.
lines.zh: : 我会狠狠评判你那些感觉。而且我几乎可以保证，我也会试图改变你——毕竟我连想象跟一个你这样的生物住在一起都做不到。

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice31
: Just saying...you’re the closest to my real mom that my dad can get. At least...among those {i}his{/i} age.
lines.zh: : 我就说说而已……在{i}我爸{/i}这个年纪的人里，你大概是离我亲妈最近的一个了。

lines.en: : And I think you guys would make a really sweet couple if you weren’t already a lesbian.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，如果你不是同性恋的话，你俩会是很甜的一对。

lines.en: : I’m...bisexual, technically.
lines.zh: : 我……严格说来是双性恋。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, maybe there’s hope after all then?
lines.zh: : 那也许还是有希望的？

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice32
: Hope for {i}what?{/i} This is absolutely not how this conversation is supposed to end. I didn’t drag you here to ask for your blessing. Plus, I’m already {i}in{/i} a relationship. Mostly.
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}希望？这场对话绝对不该这么收尾。我把你拽来不是为了求你祝福我的。再说我已经有对象了。大概吧。

lines.en: : Just saying! I might not have ever left at all if you were the one in Niki’s place!
lines.zh: : 我就说说嘛！要是当年 Niki 的位置上是你，我说不定根本不会离开！

lines.en: : So you’ll go back then? To Arakawa’s-
lines.zh: : 那你会回去了？回荒川——

lines.en: : Maybe! Later, Miss Watabe! This was actually a pretty productive talk!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！回头见，渡边老师！这番对话其实还挺有收获的！

lines.en: : Wait! Ami-
lines.zh: : 等等！Ami——

lines.en: scene wakanaamioffice33
: Fucking Arakawas...
lines.zh: : 操蛋的荒川一家……

lines.en: scene black
: Ending every single conversation by just making me more confused...
lines.zh: : 每一场对话都以把我搞得更糊涂收场……

lines.en: : Ugh...
: I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: {i}Ami is now {b}PENDING{/b}!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ami 现在处于待定状态！{/i}
